VlocityDataPackData.Name: DR-Load-LoanDecisionLoad
VlocityDataPackData.Description: Upserts LoanApplication__c with the full loan request details and initial eligibility decision from the LoanApplication OmniScript. Uses ExternalId__c for idempotent upsert. Called from LoanEligibilityIP after eligibility scoring completes.

fieldMappings.comment: Generated by OmniScript (SHA-256 of applicantId+loanType+timestamp). Drives upsert idempotency.

BRANCH_MANAGER / DIRECTOR / EXECUTIVE — set when decision = MANUAL_REVIEW

outputParameters.name: loanAppId
outputParameters.description: Salesforce Id of the upserted LoanApplication__c — returned to IP and OmniScript

outputParameters.name: loanAppName
outputParameters.description: Auto-number Name (LOAN-0001) for display in confirmation message

InputParameters.name: LoanRequest
InputParameters.description: Loan request data from OmniScript Steps 1–2: LoanType, RequestedAmount, AnnualIncome, MonthlyDebtPayments, ExternalId, ApplicantId, and loan-type-specific fields

InputParameters.name: EligibilityResult
InputParameters.description: Eligibility scoring results from WealthManagementCallable: decision, creditScore, dti, approvalTier, estimatedRate, evaluatedAt

PostLoadActions.comment: Writes loanAppId and loanAppName back to IP context so OmniScript confirmation message can reference LOAN-0001 etc.

interviewNotes.decisionToStatusTransform: The EligibilityResult:decision field is mapped to Status__c via a Lookup transform (AUTO_APPROVED→APPROVED, MANUAL_REVIEW→IN_REVIEW, DECLINED→DECLINED). This translation is declarative here instead of in Apex — keeping the DR as the single source of truth for this mapping.
interviewNotes.externalIdUpsert: ExternalId__c is required and drives the upsert. The IP generates it as SHA-256(applicantId + loanType + submissionTimestamp) before calling this DR. If the submission is retried (network failure, user resubmit), the same ExternalId__c is generated and the DR updates the existing record instead of creating a duplicate.
interviewNotes.loanTypeSpecificFields: Mortgage fields (PropertyValue, PropertyAddress, MortgagePurpose) and auto loan fields (VehicleMake, VehicleModel, VehicleYear) are all mapped here. If the input path is absent for the loan type (e.g., no VehicleMake for a MORTGAGE), the field is simply not set — no conditional logic needed in the DR.
interviewNotes.outputParameters: loanAppId and loanAppName are exposed as output parameters, written to IP context as LoanApplicationCreated:loanAppId. The OmniScript confirmation message merges this: 'Your application {LoanApplicationCreated:loanAppName} has been submitted.'
interviewNotes.approvalTierField: ApprovalTier__c stores the tier (BRANCH_MANAGER/DIRECTOR/EXECUTIVE) set when MANUAL_REVIEW. This drives the Approval Process submission in LoanEligibilityService.routeToApproval() and is visible to the assigned reviewer.
interviewNotes.triggerConsideration: This DR load triggers LoanApplicationTrigger (after update). The trigger's afterUpdate handler checks if Status__c changed to SUBMITTED and enqueues LoanEligibilityQueueable. However, at this point eligibility is already scored by the IP — the trigger guard in LoanEligibilityQueueable prevents double-evaluation by checking EligibilityDecision__c != PENDING.
